goals: cover csv, time-series csv, and hdf5
pull from both Dryad and Zenodo
prefer direct downloadable files over opaque archives
keep initial import size moderate and reviewable
notes: Larger files may still be selected if they are strongly relevant and directly usable.
Archive-heavy records were deprioritized unless no direct format-specific file was available.

sources.label: odor plume hdf5 snapshot
sources.why_selected: Direct HDF5 file with explicit scientific structure and small size compared with the larger companion files.

sources.label: greenland cod movement time series
sources.why_selected: Two direct CSV exports with temporal structure and repeated entities.
files: Season and site fidelity determine home range of dispersing and resident juvenile Greenland cod (Gadus ogac) in a Newfoundland fjord_year1.csv
Season and site fidelity determine home range of dispersing and resident juvenile Greenland cod (Gadus ogac) in a Newfoundland fjord_year2.csv

sources.label: african mammal food web tabular bundle
sources.why_selected: Multiple directly downloadable CSV files with heterogeneous but schema-rich ecological tables.

sources.label: weather station csv
sources.why_selected: Single medium-sized weather station CSV that is directly useful for time-axis and unit discovery work.

sources.label: tracked hailstorm events
sources.why_selected: Compact CSV with timestamp and geospatial fields, appropriate for retrieval and tabular profiling.

sources.label: aeolian saltation field time series
sources.why_selected: Direct sensor and wind time-series CSV files with different granularities and field layouts.

sources.label: indoor air pollutant sensor csv
sources.why_selected: Raw timestamped sensor measurements from a real deployment, selected with one smaller school file for an initial import batch.

sources.label: ATLASM5 atmospheric station h5 months
sources.why_selected: Direct monthly H5 files from an atmospheric research station; selected two months to seed hierarchical extractor evaluation.

sources.label: single h5 workshop dataset
sources.why_selected: Small standalone H5 file useful as an additional binary-format smoke case.
